ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels; high-intensity pixels are localized exclusively at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white blobs at the outer distal tips of both lobes; the left lobe patch is larger with a ragged internal border and dark pixel intrusions; the right lobe patch is smaller and concentrated at the extreme tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression estimated at 135 degrees; the vertex/peduncle insertion point is partially obscured by high-intensity splash pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude irregular notches near the tip; the right lobe trailing edge shows a higher frequency of low-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep leading to upward-tapering lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast dark circular spots clustered within the white pigmentation of the left lobe distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of approximately four dark, parallel linear marks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the white patch of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jagged indentation/loss of tissue at the extreme lateral tip of the left lobe.
